messages:
elaine park: DeployBot flagged increased 429s on streaming route after canary of v3.0.2 in us-central. Suggesting auto-rollback.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary threshold breached: 429-rate > 1% on /v1/stream (v3.0.2). Recommend auto-rollback to v3.0.1.
jonah reed: Hold auto-rollback. Streaming client SDK changed concurrency defaults. If we roll back we'll break in-flight sessions. Need to pin instead and throttle new sessions.
tara mendoza: Agree. Plan: 1) Pin existing sessions to v3.0.1 via header match 2) Throttle new sessions to 10% on v3.0.2 while we hotfix. If hotfix fails within 10m, then manual rollback + session drain.
elaine park: Ops pin command (routectl):
```bash
routectl set-weight --route streaming-us --version v3.0.1 --weight 100 --match-header "X-Session-Orig: existing"
```
jonah reed: Hotfix will reintroduce legacy concurrency fallback. Build ready as v3.0.2-hotfix. CI green.
ops-bot: Note: auto-rollback scheduled in 5m. Operator override required to cancel.
tara mendoza: Executed pin, verified counts. Existing sessions now routed to v3.0.1. New sessions limited to 10% test-slice.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary for v3.0.2-hotfix shows 0.2% 429s on test-slice. Auto-rollback cancelled by operator override.
elaine park: Customer blurb (short): "We detected increased 429s for streaming after a client-default change. We pinned ongoing sessions to the prior stable release and are rolling a hotfix. We will follow up with a postmortem and update release notes." Keep it short.
jonah reed: Decision: no global rollback. Monitor 30m, update release notes with SDK compatibility note, and add pre-deploy check for client-defaults. Closing when postmortem link added.
